acceptanceRules: The post author must be one of the people seeded in src/lib/social/top-voices.ts.
The evidence must be a native post by that top voice.
The post must have a post-level URL.
The visible post text or quoted-card context must name the S26 target company, founder, official handle, or domain.
Visible post-level metrics must be available.
The post must not already be present in source JSON or public graph JSON.
